candidate.version_description: This is my version of Balsam Range’s Gonna Be Movin. It is a fairly easy song to play, so it’s great for beginners.

content:
[Verse 1]

[tab]    [ch]G[/ch]
This old world is no place for livin'[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]G[/ch]
Not enough care, not enough givin'[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]C[/ch]                              [ch]G[/ch]
Sometime clouds of sin and sorrow hide the way[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]G[/ch]
But this life of stormy weather[/tab]
[tab]                          [ch]G[/ch]
Ain't gonna be my home forever[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]D[/ch]                     [ch]G[/ch]
Gonna be movin' - one of these days[/tab]

[tab]           [ch]G[/ch]

[tab]           [ch]C[/ch]                    [ch]G[/ch]
Gonna be movin' - one of these days[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]
When I leave this life behind me[/tab]
[tab]                                       [ch]Em[/ch]
Troubles and cares are never gonna find me[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]D[/ch]                       [ch]G[/ch]
